text: Test the analyst’s challenge that Google TPU and Amazon Trainium ramps displace more NVIDIA spending in calendar Q4 2026 than the current model assumes. Compare dated company disclosures and eligible channel evidence for current shipment, deployment and procurement timing, using SEC/IR fetches where the corpus is insufficient. Separate internal Google TPU procurement from external TPU sales, AWS chip units/service revenue from accelerator hardware dollars, incremental custom demand from NVIDIA substitution, and October–December from NVIDIA fiscal Q4 including January. Check dated NVIDIA relationships with both customers. Reassess the 65% NVIDIA base share and $127bn fiscal Q4 Data Center estimate; use compute to size defensible changes, reconcile customer-specific losses with concentration and the existing $3.19bn timing allowance, and update model/quarters if warranted. If holding, explain why and specify evidence that would move the forecast. Report the resulting street gap and implication for the NVIDIA long thesis.
